answer: Re-attestations are stored in quill and echo lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the dune graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1275 impostors cost 1886 times the honest price and take 20 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
